lines.text: The disciples ask who is greatest in the kingdom of heaven, and Jesus says whoever humbles himself like a little child.
Jesus says causing a little one to stumble is worse than drowning with a millstone, and He says to cut off a hand, foot or eye that causes sin.
Jesus says a man with a hundred sheep leaves the ninety-nine in the fold to search for one lost sheep.
If a brother sins, confront him privately, then take one or two others, and then tell the priests if he refuses to listen.
Jesus says if two agree about anything they ask, His Father in heaven will do it, and where two or three gather, He is with them.
